title: Temperature-controlled chemical delivery system and reactor system including same
abstract: A temperature control system for a chemical material delivery system (for example, included in a reactor system) comprises a temperature control shell which is coupled to and/or surrounds at least a portion of at least one component of the chemical material delivery system. The chemical material delivery system comprises filters, accumulators, and/or chemical material application lines that are fluidly coupled to each other in an optional suitable arrangement and/or configuration. The temperature control system for a chemical material delivery system comprises: a filter temperature control shell coupled to and/or surrounding at least a portion of a filter; an accumulator temperature control shell coupled to and/or surrounding at least a portion of an accumulator; and/or an application line temperature control shell coupled to and/or surrounding at least a portion of a chemical material application line.

title: Fluid flow converter with support arrangement
abstract: An apparatus for converting rotation into fluid flow and/or fluid flow into rotation. The apparatus comprises a coiled fluid conduit having an inlet and an outlet, a support arrangement holding the coiled fluid conduit such that the inlet is higher/lower the outlet, a first fluid separator configured to receive batches of first fluid and batches of second fluid output from the outlet of the coiled fluid conduit and separate the first fluid and the second fluid, and an intrastage flow channel connecting the first fluid separator with the inlet of the coiled fluid conduit to allow second fluid separated by the first fluid separator to be transported back towards the inlet of the coiled fluid conduit.

title: Cooling device
abstract: To provide a cooling device capable of quickly solving clogging of a filter without causing failure.SOLUTION: A cooling device has: a case 3 in which an apparatus 2 cooled by a fluid which is a liquid is stored; a circulation passage 4 formed at the case 3 and connected to a supply port 10 for supplying a fluid into the case 3 and to a discharge port 11 for discharging the fluid from the case 3, respectively; a normal rotation side filter 6 provided at the discharge port 11; a pump 7 provided at the circulation passage 4; and a control device 8 for controlling an operation of the pump 7. By switching a fluid discharge direction of the pump 7 by the control device 8, switching is possible between a normal mode for delivering the fluid discharged from the discharge port 11 to the supply port 10 via the circulation passage 4 and a reverse rotation mode for delivering the fluid into the case 3 from the discharge port 11.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Gas supply system that can replace the flow controller without interruption of the process
abstract: The present invention relates to a gas supply system and, more specifically, to a gas supply system capable of replacing a mast flow controller without causing a process suspension by using two MFC lines with operations switchable with each other. In accordance with the present invention, the gas supply system capable of replacing a mast flow controller without causing a process suspension, includes: a source gas supply line through which source gas is supplied; a mixing tank connected with the source gas supply line and storing process gas including the source gas; and a process gas supply line connected with the mixing tank and supplying the process gas.

title: Large two-stroke uniflow scavenged turbocharged internal combustion engine with ammonia absorption system
abstract: To provide a large two-stroke uniflow scavenged turbocharged internal combustion engine having at least one operation mode in which ammonia is used as main fuel.SOLUTION: An engine comprises: at least one cylinder having a cylinder liner, a reciprocating piston in the cylinder liner, and a cylinder cover covering the cylinder; a combustion chamber formed between the reciprocating piston in the cylinder and the cylinder cover; an ammonia fuel system (30) configured to supply pressurized ammonia to fuel valves disposed in the cylinder cover or the cylinder liner; and an ammonia evacuation flow path (42, 44, 47) that connects an outlet of the ammonia fuel system to an inlet of an ammonia absorption system. The ammonia absorption system makes ammonia water during use by causing ammonia supplied through the ammonia evacuation flow path to be absorbed in water.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: Semiconductor device and method for fabricating the same
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a substrate, a first wiring pattern on an upper surface of the substrate, and a second wiring pattern on the upper surface of the substrate. The first wiring pattern includes a first crystal and a second crystal adjacent to the first crystal in a horizontal direction. A crystal orientation of each of the first crystal and the second crystal is in a vertical direction perpendicular to the upper surface of the substrate. An interface between the first crystal and the second crystal extends in the vertical direction. The second wiring pattern is spaced apart from the first wiring pattern in the horizontal direction.

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device including a substrate, a first metal pattern, a first insulating pattern, and a second metal pattern. The first metal pattern is disposed on the substrate. The first insulating pattern is disposed on the first metal pattern. The second metal pattern is disposed on the first metal pattern and the first insulating pattern. The second metal pattern includes a first contact portion and a second contact portion, which contact the first metal pattern in a direction of a section view. The first insulating pattern contacts the first metal pattern and the second first metal pattern between the first contact portion and the second contact portion.

title: Transfer substrate, electronic device and manufacturing method of transfer substrate
abstract: To provide a transfer substrate capable of improving a yield, an electronic device and a manufacturing method of the transfer substrate.SOLUTION: A transfer substrate comprises: a substrate including a first top face; a conductive film which is provided on the substrate and includes a second top face; and a first insulator film which is provided on the substrate and directly in contact with the conductive film and includes a third top face continued to the second top face. The second top face and the third top face are tilted from the first top face in a boundary between the second top face and the third top face.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Semiconductor Device
abstract: To provide a semiconductor device and an electronic system including the same that improve reliability and performance.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device 10 includes a gate stack structure 120 including a first stack structure 120a and a second stack structure 120b that are sequentially stacked, respectively including a plurality of gate electrodes 130, a channel structure CH penetrating the gate stack structure, a plurality of gate contact portions 184 respectively connected to the plurality of gate electrodes in first and second pad regions formed in each stack structure, and a buffer insulating portion 132p formed in the first stack structure including a boundary part of the first stack structure adjacent to the second stack structure in a part where the second pad region is located. The buffer insulating portion includes an inner region, a first region located on one side of the inner region in an extension direction of the plurality of gate electrodes, and a second region located on the other side, and the first and second regions are each longer in the extension direction at an upper portion than at a lower portion, and a difference between the length at the upper portion and the length at the lower portion is larger in the second region than in the first region.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Integrated circuit, preparation method therefor, three-dimensional integrated circuit and electronic apparatus
abstract: Some embodiments of this application provide an integrated circuit and a preparation method thereof, a three-dimensional integrated circuit, and an electronic device, and relate to the field of semiconductor technologies, to improve product reliability of the three-dimensional integrated circuit. The integrated circuit includes a substrate, an electronic component, a wiring layer, a dielectric bonding layer, a connection pattern, and a barrier layer. The electronic component is disposed on the substrate. The wiring layer is disposed on the substrate, and is electrically connected to the electronic component. The wiring layer includes a metal trace. The dielectric bonding layer is disposed on a side that is of the wiring layer and that is away from the substrate. The connection pattern runs through the dielectric bonding layer, and is electrically connected to the metal trace. The connection pattern includes a seed layer and a conductive block that are stacked, and the seed layer is located on a side that is of the conductive block and that is close to the substrate. The barrier layer is disposed between the conductive block and the dielectric bonding layer, and surrounds a side surface of the conductive block. The foregoing integrated circuit can be used to form a three-dimensional integrated circuit through hybrid bonding.

title: System and method for remotely monitoring vehicle, robot or drone
abstract: To provide a system and a method for remotely monitoring and controlling a vehicle, a robot or a drone.SOLUTION: This system has: a control module containing a computer-executable code stored in a non-volatile memory; a processor: a control center device; and a plurality of autonomous devices that operate remotely from the control center device, in which each of the plurality of autonomous devices includes a control device. The control module, processor, control center device, and control device are configured to: acquire data using one or more acquisition units located in each of the plurality of autonomous device; process the acquired data using the control devices located on the plurality of autonomous devices; transfer the processed data from the control devices to the control center device in the case that the plurality of autonomous devices are operating autonomously without control from the control center device; and train artificial intelligence according to the processed data transferred from the control device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Work instruction method using smart devices
abstract: The present invention provides a method, which comprises the steps of: transmitting process data collected by a smart device (100) to a control unit (200); receiving, by the control unit (200), the collected process data, and analyzing the process data to generate analysis data; determining, by the control unit (200), positive data from the generated analysis data and learning the data; determining a work method in which the smart device (100) is located and a work condition of the product to be worked in the work method, by the control unit (200), and determining the positive data corresponding to the work condition and a location of the smart device (200) corresponding to the positive data to generate instruction data; and, by the control unit 200, transmitting the generated instruction data to the smart device (100).

title: Method, server and system for providing movables management service
abstract: To provide a method, a server and a system for providing a movables management service to a holder of movables by generating status information of the movables based on information on the movables.SOLUTION: A method, a server, and a system for providing a movables management service include: receiving measurement data collected by an asset information acquisition device attached to movables from the asset information acquisition device; deriving state information associated with at least one of the movables and the asset information acquisition device based on the measurement data; and transmitting status information to a holder terminal owned by a collateral entity providing collateral for the movables. The state information may include at least one of location information and preset event detection information of the movables.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: How to manage virtual monitoring by tracking device motion
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for managing the virtual monitoring of a device by tracking the motion of the device. An object of the present invention is to determine the operating state of a device even if a manager does not go directly to an industrial site and manage very effectively the device in the industrial site. A method for managing the virtual monitoring of a device by tracking the motion of a device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a setting step (S10) of setting a recipe waveform for one operation of the device; a measurement step (S20) of transmitting current waveform information to a management server (10); an implementation step (S30) of implementing the real-time operation state of the device as an image and providing it to a manager; and a management step (S40).

title: Method for Using Exteroceptive Sensor Data Based on Vehicle State or Mission State
abstract: An autonomous vehicle is disclosed. The autonomous vehicle may include a sensor array; an engine output control system; a braking control system; and a controller. The controller may be communicatively coupled with the sensor array, the engine output control system, and the braking control system. The controller may be configured to: sense an environment with the sensor array to produce sensor data; receiving autonomous vehicle state data; determining whether the autonomous vehicle state data is above a threshold state value; in the event the autonomous vehicle state data is above a threshold state value, not using the sensor data to operate the autonomous vehicle; and in the event the autonomous vehicle state data is not above a threshold state value, using the sensor data to operate the autonomous vehicle.

title: Mobile body, information processing device used for automatic driving of the mobile body, automated system, method therefor and program
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an information processing device capable of attaining cost reduction of a mobile including an automatic driving function. SOLUTION: An information processing device provided in a communication network comprises: a function distributed execution unit for executing, in a distributed manner, a part of automatic driving functions which are executed in automatic driving of a mobile body moving along a moving route in place of the mobile body; and a communication unit for receiving, from the mobile body through the communication network, information required for the distributed execution of the function in a part of the automatic driving functions in the automatic driving of the mobile body, and transmitting a result of the distributed execution of the partial function through the communication network to the mobile body. SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1 COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title: Image formation apparatus
abstract: To provide an image formation apparatus which can suppress unauthorized use.SOLUTION: An image formation apparatus 1 comprises: an imaging unit 21; a storage unit 22; a collation unit 23; a determination unit 24; and a control unit 25. The imaging unit 21 acquires image data by imaging the peripheral scenery of the image formation apparatus 1. The storage unit 22 stores first registered image data registered by imaging the peripheral scenery of an installation schedule place of the image formation apparatus 1. The collation unit 23 collates the image data with the first registered image data to output first collation data. The determination unit 24 determines whether or not the image formation apparatus 1 is installed at the installation schedule place on the basis of the first collation data to output determination information. The control unit 25 drives a drive system of the image formation apparatus 1 on the basis of the determination information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Device and system
abstract: To provide a mechanism that is able to realize high performance of a mobile body further easily.SOLUTION: A device is mounted on a mobile body and used for controlling the mobile body. The device includes a holding portion and a control unit. The holding portion holds an information processor that controls the mobile body. The control unit acquires control information for controlling the mobile body from the information processor and controls the mobile body, based on the control information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Control system, control apparatus, device, control method, and program
abstract: To provide a control system, a control apparatus, a device, a control method, and a program, capable of allowing a user to confirm an operation condition of the device at a real-time.SOLUTION: A control system comprises: a device 2 that transmits device state information indicating an own machine state in each preset reference period; and a control apparatus 1 that controls the device on the basis of the command information for operating the device 2 transmitted from the terminal device. The control apparatus 1 includes: a control information generating part 112 that generates control information for controlling the device 2 on the basis of the command; a first transmission part 116 that transmits the control information generated by the control information generating part 112 to the device 2; a notice generation part 114 that generates completion notice information that notifies the completion of a setting in accordance with the command information of the device 2 on the basis of the device state information and the command information; and a second transmission part 115 that transmits the completion notice information generated by the notice generation part 114 to the terminal device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Information notification device, information notification system, and information notification method
abstract: To provide an information notification device that notifies an operator of information and is capable of further accurately providing notification with simple configuration.SOLUTION: An information notification device 100 includes: an operation state information acquisition unit 111 that acquires operation state information of a manufacturing device; and an operation determination unit 112 that determines an operation state of the manufacturing device. The information notification device 100 also includes a wireless signal information acquisition unit that acquires received power information indicating received power of a wireless signal transmitted from the manufacturing device to a portable terminal. The information notification device 100 also includes a position calculation unit 114 that calculates an operator distance from the manufacturing device to the operator based on the received power information. The information notification device 100 also includes a distance determination unit 115 that determines, based on the operator distance and a determination distance, a distance of the operator. The information notification device 100 further includes an abnormality information transmission unit 116 that transmits abnormality information to the portable terminal of the operator upon determination that the operator distance is greater than or equal to the determination distance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Dynamic power rail floating for cdac circuits
abstract: Techniques are described to address P-MOS bias temperature instability (BTI) stress issues within capacitive radio frequency digital-to-analog converter (CDAC) using a circuit architecture solution that functions to protect the transistors in various operating conditions. Techniques are disclosed that function to float one or both of the negative and positive power supply rail voltages higher or lower, respectively, for CDAC cells depending upon various operating scenarios. These scenarios include the transmitting state of individual CDAC cells and the transmitting state of the CDAC array in which the CDAC cell is implemented.

title: Switching circuit
abstract: In one embodiment, an impedance matching network includes a variable reactance circuit having fixed reactance components and corresponding switching circuits. Each switching circuit includes a diode and a driver circuit. The driver circuit includes, coupled in series, a biasing current source positioned to provide a bias current to bias the diode, a first switch, a second switch, and a resistor. For each diode of each switching circuit, the control circuit is configured to receive a value related to a voltage drop on the resistor and, based on the value related to the voltage drop, adjust the bias current being provided by the biasing current source.

title: Multi-mode oscillation circuitry with stepping control
abstract: An apparatus is disclosed for implementing multi-mode oscillation circuitry with stepping control. In an example aspect, the multi-mode oscillation circuitry comprises a resonator coupled to a first oscillator and a second oscillator. The multi-mode oscillation circuitry is configured to selectively be in a first configuration with the first oscillator in an active state and the second oscillator in an inactive state or a second configuration with the first oscillator in the inactive state and the second oscillator in the active state. The apparatus also includes a step-control circuit coupled to the multi-mode oscillation circuitry. The step-control circuit is configured to cause the first oscillator to switch from the inactive state to the active state and incrementally increase a first gain of the first oscillator based on the first oscillator being in the active state to enable the multi-mode oscillation circuitry to transition from the second configuration to the first configuration.

title: Signal processing device
abstract: To provide a signal processing device capable of restricting its manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: A signal processing device 1 is configured including: a signal processing part 2 at least having a first operational amplifier 41 and a second operational amplifier 42; a first switch 51 for changing the connection between a signal source and a first non-inverting input terminal 410, and between a reference voltage VCOM and the first non-inverting input terminal 410; a second switch 52 for changing the connection between the signal source and a second non-inverting input terminal 420 and between the reference voltage VCOM and the second non-inverting input terminal 420; and a control part 7 for defining an offset amount 72 of a first processing signal S5a based on a second processing signal S5b outputted from the signal processing part 2 by the connection of the reference voltage VCOM, the first non-inverting input terminal 410, and the second non-inverting input terminal 420, due to the changes of the first switch 51 and the second switch 52.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Reconfigurable, high stability gate-tunneling physical unclonable function with differential pulse-width modulation analog front-end interface
abstract: There is provided a circuit for a physical unclonable function comprising: first and second outputs; a cell comprising a plurality of CMOS devices; and a plurality of switching devices, the plurality of switching devices operable to connect a gate terminal of each of the plurality of CMOS devices to one of the first and second outputs, wherein a quantity of the plurality CMOS devices is a multiple of two, and wherein the circuit is configured such that each of the first and second output is connected to an equal quantity of the plurality of CMOS devices.

title: Multispecific and multifunctional molecular and use of the same
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide used in cancer treatment. SOLUTION: A multispecific or a multifunctional molecular polypeptide includes: (i) a tumor targeting portion binding to cancer antigen, which is a first tumor targeting portion for example; (ii) an immunocyte engager selected from an NK-cell engager, a T-cell engager, a B-cell engager, a dendritic cell engager or a macrophage cell engager; (iii) cytokine molecules; and (iv) two or all of interstitial adjustment portions. SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A-1C COPYRIGHT: (C)2022,JPO&INPIT

title: Antibody drug conjugates and methods for making thereof
abstract: ANTIBODY DRUG CONJUGATES AND METHODS FOR MAKING THEREOF ABSTRACT This application discloses microorganisms and methods of producing GNAQ/GNAl l inhibitors and methods of making antibody drug conjugates of anti PMEL17 antibodies or antigen binding fragments conjugated to a GNAQ/GNAl l inhibitor. The disclosure also relates to formulations comprising antibody drug conjugates of anti-PMEL17 antibodies or antigen binding fragments conjugated to a GNAQ/GNAl l inhibitor and methods of treating or preventing cancer using the formulations.

title: Methods and compositions for generating chimeric antigen receptor-monocytes/macrophages
abstract: The present disclosure relates, in part, to methods and compositions for generating monocytes, macrophages, and/or precursors thereof (such as an induced pluripotent stem cell), comprising (i) a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR); (ii) a polynucleotide encoding a CAR; (iii) a CAR polypeptide; and/or (iv) a vector comprising a polynucleotide encoding a CAR. Methods for treating a cancer using cells expressing the CAR are also provided herein. In some embodiments, the cells expressing the CAR comprise a genetic disruption of a S1RPA gene, CISH gene, and/or SIGLEC10 gene.

title: Tcbuster-m transposase-specific binding proteins and uses thereof
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to antigen-binding affinity reagents for an analyte-of-interest. In particular, the present disclosure provides novel binding proteins (antibodies), including derivatives and fragments thereof, that target TcB-M transposase, which is involved in genome editing or engineering.

title: Crispr-cas-related methods, compositions and components for cancer immunotherapy
abstract: To provide CRISPR/CAS-related compositions and methods for treatment of cancer.SOLUTION: The present invention provides a gRNA molecule comprising a targeting domain complementary to a target domain derived from a FAS, BID, CTLA4, PDCD1, CBLB, PTPN6, TRAC or TRBC gene, wherein the targeting domain is configured to provide a cleavage event selected from a double strand break and a single strand break within 500, 400, 300, 200, 100, 50, 25, or 10 nucleotides of a T cell target knockout position.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Falling prevention apparatus and image forming apparatus
abstract: A falling prevention apparatus includes: a falling prevention member: attached to a target apparatus; and protruding outward from a side face of the target apparatus with a protrusion amount in a protruding direction; and a protrusion amount changer to change the protrusion amount.

title: Methods and apparatus for multi-axis determinant assembly control
abstract: Methods and apparatus for multi-axis determinant assembly adjustment are disclosed. A disclosed example apparatus includes a base mounted to an assembly jig, a support having an interface surface to support a portion of a panel component, a pin to rotationally couple the support to the base, the support to rotate relative to the base about an axis of rotation of the pin, and an adjuster to cause translation of the pin along a slot of the base to move the support.

title: Yoke snapping testing device
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus for inspecting the presence/absence of a snap ring of a yoke. According to the present invention, a coupling member to which a yoke is detachably attached is installed on an upper surface of a moving plate, an inspection pedestal that moves a torque transmission member to the rear end of a yoke shaft is installed on the upper surface of the moving plate to move forward and backward, a pressure sensor that detects the pressure generated from the torque transmission member according to the presence or absence of a snap ring mounted on the yoke shaft is installed to be connected to a control unit, and the control unit installs and configures an alarm generator that generates an alarm sound according to a control signal of the control unit when no detection signal is received from the pressure sensor to be connected to the control unit, and eventually, it is possible to prevent in advance that the yoke on which a barcode is printed is not equipped with a snap ring that prevents the detachment of the torque transmission member, the reliability of the product can be improved since a snap ring is always attached to the yoke on which a barcode is printed, and it is possible to inspect whether a snap ring is mounted on the yoke shaft before a barcode is printed on the yoke or even after the barcode is printed, thereby increasing work efficiency.

title: Releasable clamp
abstract: A releasable clamp 10 for holding an article 1000 or parts thereof is describe. The clamp 10 comprises: a set of jaws, including a first jaw 100 A and a second jaw 100 B, arrangeable to hold the article 1000 therebetween; a set of spacers, including a first spacer 200 A, arrangeable to space apart respective jaws of the set of jaws; and a set of retaining members, including a first retaining member 300 A, arrangeable to space together respective jaws of the set of jaws; wherein respective jaws of the set of jaws comprise a first region 110 for contacting the article 1000 , an optional second region 120 defining a portion of a first part 410 of a coupling member 400 , a third region 130 for contacting a respective spacer of the set of spacers and a fourth region 140 for contacting a respective retaining member of the set of retaining members. The clamp 10 is configurable in: a first configuration, wherein the first jaw 100 A and the second jaw 100 B are mutually unjoined; and a second configuration, wherein the first spacer 200 A is arranged to space apart the first jaw 100 A and the second jaw 100 B and wherein the first retaining member 300 A is arranged to apply a net compressive force on the first spacer 200 A via the first jaw 100 A and the second jaw 100 B, whereby the first jaw 100 A and the second jaw 100 B are conjoined and thereby hold the article 1000 therebetween.

title: Adjusting device
abstract: The present invention relates to an adjusting device for positioning an object, said adjusting device comprising: a base which is designed to move an object, that can be connected to the base, in a position-controlled manner along a movement path when said object is connected; and a supply line for transmitting power and/or signals to and/or from the base. According to the invention, the supply line is coupled to the base in a reversibly detachable manner in order to prevent damage to the supply line and/or to the base in the event of an unforeseen movement of the adjusting device and in order to facilitate handling of the adjusting device.

title: Pressure-sensitive adhesive composition, pressure-sensitive adhesive film, optical film with pressure-sensitive adhesive layer, liquid crystal panel
abstract: To provide: a pressure-sensitive adhesive composition which can make excellent antistatic performance and durability including pressure-sensitive adhesive performance compatible with each other; a pressure-sensitive adhesive film; an optical film with a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer; and a liquid crystal panel.SOLUTION: A pressure-sensitive adhesive composition is provided which comprises an acrylic polymer, an antistatic agent, and a cross-linking agent. The acrylic polymer has a glass transition temperature of 0°C or less. The cross-linking agent is one or more selected from the group consisting of tri- or more functional isocyanate compounds and di- or more functional epoxy compounds. The pressure-sensitive adhesive composition does not contain a plasticizer and includes a silane coupling agent of a monomer type having at least one functional group selected from an epoxy group, a mercapto group, and an acid anhydride group or of an oligomer type. The antistatic agent is an ionic compound having a melting point of 25°C or more, wherein the anion is one selected from a trifluoromethanesulfonate anion, a pentafluoroethanesulfonate anion, a heptafluoropropanesulfonate anion, and a nonafluorobutanesulfonate anion.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Belt for papermaking and method for producing belt for papermaking
abstract: [Problem] To provide a belt which is for papermaking and in which a resin in a resin layer is inhibited from coming off during use, and a method for producing the belt for papermaking. [Solution] A belt for papermaking according to an embodiment of the present invention is to be used in a paper-making machine, and has at least one resin layer containing a resin. The total number of bulges having a height of at least 50 μm and cracks having a length of at least 10 mm is at most 1.0/m 2 in at least one surface of the resin layer. A belt for papermaking according to another embodiment of the present invention is to be used in a paper-making machine, and has at least one resin layer containing a resin. The resin layer is formed using a resin composition containing an aqueous urethane resin dispersion. The resin composition contains an organic solvent having a boiling point of 100°C or higher under a pressure of 1 atm.

title: Release film for transfer mold and method for manufacturing semiconductor chip encapsulation
abstract: To provide: a release film for a transfer mold which is capable of imparting excellent designability and has excellent moldability during molding process and excellent residual reduction after peeling off the release film; and a method for manufacturing a semiconductor chip encapsulation.SOLUTION: A release film for a semiconductor transfer mold is made up of a base material layer and a release layer, and includes the release layer on at least a surface of one side. The base material layer contains 0.1-30 mass% of particles.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Surface modification sheet, laminate, surface modification member, painted object, surface modification member manufacturing method, and painted object manufacturing method
abstract: The present invention relates to: a surface-modifying sheet including a release sheet and a surface-modifying layer, wherein the surface-modifying layer has a 160°C storage modulus of 5.0×10 3 to 1.0×10 7 Pa and the surface-modifying layer has a surface tension of 38 mN/m or higher; a laminate; a surface-modified member and a coated article both produced using the surface-modifying sheet; a method for producing the surface-modified member; and a method for producing the coated article.

title: Varnish, optical film, and method for producing optical film
abstract: To provide a varnish capable of forming an optical film that is prevented from increasing in YI value due to UV irradiation, and an optical film formed from the varnish.SOLUTION: A varnish contains at least a solvent and a polyimide resin. In the varnish the content of dicarboxylic acid is 10 ppm or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Methods, systems, and arrays for biomolecular analysis
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide high-throughput techniques for analyzing target samples in fields such as diagnostic microbiology including detection and identification of pathogens. SOLUTION: Evaluation methods, evaluation substrates, and methods of producing arrays are disclosed. A method of obtaining peptide binding data comprises steps of; obtaining a peptide array having at least 10,000 peptide features per square millimeter; contacting the array with a sample containing a plurality of ligands for at least a subset of the 100,000 peptide features under condition that promote ligand binding; and imaging the array to identify binding of the plurality of ligands to the peptide array. SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 24 COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title: Compositions, methods and systems for protein corona analysis from biofluids and uses thereof
abstract: This disclosure provides methods and compositions for biomolecule corona analysis of biofluids. A biofluid may be contacted with a nanoparticle to form a biomolecule corona, and the composition of the resulting corona may be analyzed. Also provided are methods of preparing a biofluid for corona analysis by serial interrogation.

title: System and sensor array
abstract: The present disclosure provides a system comprising a communication interface and computer for assigning a label to the biomolecule fingerprint, wherein the label corresponds to a biological state. The present disclosure also provides a sensor arrays for detecting biomolecules and methods of use. In some embodiments, the sensor arrays are capable of determining a disease state in a subject.

title: Compressed open flow assay and use
abstract: The present invention relates to the methods, devices, and systems that make bio/chemical sensing (including, not limited to, immunoassay, nucleic assay, electrolyte analysis, etc.) faster, more sensitive, less steps, easy to perform, smaller amount of samples required, less or reduced (or no) needs for professional assistance, and/or lower cost, than many current sensing methods and devices. The present invention also allow a test performed by a smartphone.

title: Portable devices and methods for detecting and identifying compounds in a fluid sample
abstract: This disclosure relates to portable devices for detecting various compounds for the detection of diseases.

title: Parsing event data for clustering and classification
abstract: In some implementations, a classification system may receive credentials associated with a data source and may receive, from the data source and using the credentials, a set of structured data including input events and output events. The classification system may filter the set of structured data by applying a first set of rules to generate a filtered set of structured data and may convert the filtered set of structured data to one or more numerical vectors, where a vector space associated with the one or more numerical vectors is infinite-dimensional. The classification system may further cluster the one or more numerical vectors using a first machine learning model to generate one or more clusters. Accordingly, the classification system may determine one or more classifications based on the set of structured data, each of the one or more classifications being associated with a corresponding frequency and a corresponding category.

title: Using secure MPC and vector computations to protect access to information in content distribution
abstract: This disclosure relates to protecting the security of information in content selection and distribution. In one aspect, a method includes receiving, from a client device and by a first computing system of multi-party computation (MPC) systems, a digital component request including first secret shares of data identifying user groups that include a user of the client device as a member. The first computing system transmits a contextual digital component request to a content platform. The first computing system receives, from the content platform, selection data for multiple digital components. The selection data includes first vector data defining a contextual-based vector of values selected based in part on the set of contextual signals. The first computing system obtains, for each digital component, second vector data defining a user group-based vector of values selected based in part on a respective user group corresponding to the digital component.

title: Method and apparatus for poviding digital twin federation service
abstract: Provided is a method for providing a digital twin association service in a digital twin association service providing apparatus of any one digital twin. The digital twin association service providing apparatus collects domain-specific data of the digital twin and association data according to association with at least one other digital twin in a domain different from the digital twin, collects external data from an external server, analyzes the domain-specific data, the association data, and the external data to recognize a multilateral situation, and provides an intelligent service based on the multilateral situation.

title: AI-based system and method for establishing channelized communications
abstract: AI-based system for establishing channelized communications and resource management for an organization. The system includes: a processor of a channel server node connected to an organization network; a memory on which are stored machine-readable instructions that when executed by the processor, cause the processor to: monitor the at least one organization network to collect analytics data comprising workflow data, generate a plurality of classifiers based on the analytics data, the plurality of classifiers comprising data reflecting nodes and associated pivot objects of the at least one organization network, feed the plurality of classifiers to an AI/ML module configured to output configuration parameters for at least one communication channel; and generate the at least one communication channel for the at least one organization network based on the configuration parameters.

title: Device and operating method for providing digital twin platform services
abstract: Disclosed is a digital twin platform service device comprising: an interface module which receives data from a real object, displays a result calculated based on the received data on a digital twin, and transmits a control signal related to the result displayed on the digital twin to the real object; and a block combination module which combines a plurality of blocks each providing a designated function to generate a service module for managing the real object, wherein the service module calculates the result displayed on the digital twin based on the received data. In addition, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible.

title: Polymer member-inorganic based matrix complex, manufacturing method thereof and polymer member therefor
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a useful method to bond a polymer member to an inorganic matrix without using glue, and the polymer member for this purpose. SOLUTION: A polymer member-inorganic based matrix complex, a manufacturing method thereof and a polymer member therefor are provided. A method to manufacture the polymer member-inorganic based matrix complexes 210, 220 includes: providing a thermal modified polymer layer-inorganic based matrix complexes 110, 120 in which one or multiple thermal modified polymer layers 20, 21, 22 adhere on an inorganic based matrix 10; and joining polymer member 30, 31, 32 to the inorganic based matrix with one or multiple thermal modified polymer layers 20, 21, 22. title: Chemically modified multifunctional inorganic particles
abstract: A composition comprising modified multifunctional inorganic particles is provided. An article or composite comprising a thermoplastic polymer or a plurality of immiscible polymers and the modified particles homogenously distributed therewithin is provided. Further, a method for preparing the composites is provided.

title: Chemical treatment of components
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of treatment of objects produced by an additive manufacturing method, having at least one surface formed from a polymer having a glass transition temperature of at least 120°C, and preferably being formed from such a polymer, and in which the surface of the object is contacted with an organic or inorganic solvent. Such a treatment can smooth the surface of the objects and improve relevant mechanical properties. The present invention further relates to three-dimensional objects produced by such a method and to the use of organic or inorganic solvents for reduction of surface roughness and/or for improvement of mechanical properties and/or chemical stability.

title: Photoactive polymer coatings
abstract: Photoactive polymer coatings and methods of making the same are disclosed herein. In some embodiments, a polymer coating comprises a polymer matrix having a porous structure extending throughout the polymer matrix, wherein the porous structure is present at an exposed surface of the polymer coating creating a roughened surface, and a modified support particle disposed within the polymer matrix, wherein the modified support particle includes a substituted phthalocyanine and a support particle. In some embodiments, the substituted phthalocyanine is a halogenated phthalocyanine.

title: Foam formed solid composite
abstract: The present invention relates to a foam formed solid composite, comprising: a matrix phase consisting of a mixture of nanocellulose, at least one foaming agent, and optional additives, and a dispersed phase consisting of solid low-density particles having a density of less than 1.2 kg/dm3. The present invention further relates to a method and a liquid foam composition for manufacturing the solid composite.

title: Optical inspection device for high speed and high precision alignment using multi-camera
abstract: The present invention relates to an optical inspection device for high-speed and high-precision alignment using a multi-camera, and the optical inspection device is capable of aligning and inspecting glass and a fine metal mask (FMM) by simultaneously measuring different points along a height axis using a multi-camera. In detail, alignment marks on a flat glass surface and an FMM surface are measured at the same time by using a multi-camera to check an alignment state, and a position is accurately aligned. Then, the flat glass surface and the FMM surface are in close contact with each other to be deposited, and an alignment state is inspected. According to the present invention, the optical inspection device for high-speed and high-precision alignment using a multi-camera comprises: a light source for generating light; a first beam splitter and a second beam splitter for changing a path direction of the light generated from the light source; an objective lens for condensing and irradiating the light, of which the path has been converted in the first beam splitter and the second beam splitter, to the glass surface and the FMM surface; a wave plate for forming an optical path difference (phase difference) before the light is irradiated to the glass surface and the FMM surface so that each light can be condensed and irradiated; a height measurement unit for measuring heights of the glass surface and the FMM surface in real time; first and second detection units composed of a plurality of cameras or imaging devices for receiving and detecting the light separated through the first beam splitter and the second beam splitter; and a galvanometer for detecting positions of the glass surface and the FMM surface.

title: Progressive metalens for sensing system
abstract: A meta lens includes areas of at least one nanostructure. A first area of the nanostructure leads a first FOV of light inputted into the first area of the nanostructure to head toward a first area of an image plane. A second area of the nanostructure leads a second FOV of light inputted into the second area of the nanostructure to head toward a second area of the image plane, the second FOV is different from the first FOV, and the second area of the image plane is different from the first area of the image plane. A third FOV of the nanostructure leads a third FOV of light to head toward a third area of the image plane, the third FOV is different from the first FOV and the second FOV, and the third area of the image plane is different from the first area of the image plane and the second area of the image plane. Therefore, the present invention is capable of allowing lower sensor-space resolution with a reduced processing ability.

title: optical scanner
abstract: To provide an optical scanner that can widen an eye-box with a simple structure and also can widen an angle of field.SOLUTION: The optical scanner includes: a light source for emitting a laser beam; a mirror device having a movable mirror which rocks around at least one axis, the mirror device reflecting the laser beam from the light source by the movable mirror and changing the direction of the laser beam; and a light collection optical system for collecting the laser beam of which direction has been changed by the mirror device. The light collection optical system includes: a half mirror with a recessed surface; and a diffusion plate with a plurality of micro mirrors for diffusing the laser beam having passed through the half mirror from the recessed surface side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: Apparatus and method for measuring modified area of substrate
abstract: To provide a substrate reforming area measuring device.SOLUTION: The imaging apparatus includes a first imaging device 101, a second imaging device 102, a third imaging device 103, and a microcomputer unit 104. The first imaging device faces the first surface of the substrate 110 and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a first image. The second imaging device faces the second surface of the substrate and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a second image. The first surface of the substrate is opposite to the second surface of the substrate. The third imaging device obliquely faces the first surface of the substrate or the second surface of the substrate, and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a third image. The micro-processor unit obtains a modified area measurement information of at least one modified area of the substrate according to the first image, the second image and the third image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Image acquisition apparatus
abstract: Provided is an image acquisition apparatus capable of acquiring a clear and high-resolution stereo image by increasing the depth of field for a thick subject or a subject with inconsistent thickness. An image acquisition apparatus according to an exemplary embodiment of the present invention includes: a polarizing prism unit for splitting an incident light beam; and a plurality of image collecting units for collecting the split light beam from the polarizing prism unit, in which the polarizing prism unit includes: a first polarization unit having a first polarization angle obtained by adding half a binocular parallax angle of a person to 45°, and a second polarization unit disposed to be in contact with the first polarization unit and having a second polarization angle obtained by subtracting half of the binocular parallax angle of a person from 45°.

title: Compounds for treating proliferative diseases
abstract: The present disclosure provides compounds of Formula (I): (I). The compounds described herein may be useful in treating and/or preventing proliferative diseases (e.g., cancer). Also provided in the present disclosure are pharmaceutical compositions, kits, methods, and uses including or using a compound described herein.

title: Amide compounds and uses thereof
abstract: Provided herein are novel amide compounds of formula (I), pharmaceutical compositions comprising same, methods for preparing same, and uses thereof, wherein the definition of each symbol is as described in the description.

title: Azaquinazoline ring derivative and use thereof
abstract: The present invention provides an azaquinazoline ring derivative and a use thereof. Specifically, the present invention provides a compound of formula I, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, tautomer, stereoisomer, stereoisomer mixture or isotopic substitute thereof. The compound has excellent cancer Osaka thyroid (Cot) kinase inhibitory activity, and thus can be used for preventing or treating (Cot) kinase-mediated diseases or disorders.

title: Compound acting as parp7 inhibitor
abstract: The present invention relates to a biaromatic compound acting as a PARP7 inhibitor. Specifically, the present invention relates to a compound of formula (I), or an enantiomer, diastereomer, racemate, tautomer, stereoisomer, geometric isomer, nitrogen oxide, metabolite or pharmaceutically acceptable salt, ester, solvate, hydrate, isotope-labeled compound or prodrug thereof. The present invention also relates to a use of the compound for treating or preventing PARP7-mediated diseases, such as cancer, immune diseases, inflammation or viral infections.

title: Phenyl amide compounds and methods of use
abstract: The present application relates to compounds of Formula (I), as defined herein, and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof. The present application also describes pharmaceutical composition comprising a compound of Formula (I), and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, and methods of using the compounds and compositions for inhibiting certain protein-protein interactions, and for treating cancer.

title: Method and device for dynamic switching between downlink data channel transmission or reception schemes in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting higher data transfer rates. Specifically, the present discourse provides a method of receiving, by a terminal, transmission configuration indicator (TCI) state information in a wireless communication system, the method comprising the steps of: receiving information on a TCI state from a base station; obtaining a parameter relating to at least one of an uplink transmission beam and a downlink reception beam on the basis of the received information on the TCI state; and transmitting or receiving data to or from the base station on the basis of the determined parameter.

title: Techniques for precoding air-to-air sidelink communications
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A first user equipment (UE) may receive a message indicating geographic location information related to beamforming an air-to-air sidelink message via a sidelink channel. In some examples, a second UE may transmit the message or a base station may transmit the message. The message may be the same or different as a message scheduling the sidelink message. The geographic location information may be geographic location information associated with the second UE, geographic location information associated with one or more directions to avoid when beamforming the sidelink message, or a combination thereof. The first UE may identify one or more precoding parameters based on the geographic location information. The first UE may transmit the air-to-air sidelink message to the second UE. The sidelink message may be precoded for transmission via a transmission beam using the one or more precoding parameters.

title: Terminal and control method thereof in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or pre-5G communication system for supporting higher data transfer rates than that of a beyond 4G communication system such as LTE. A control method of a terminal in a wireless communication system, according to an embodiment of the present invention, may comprise the steps of: receiving radio resource control signaling (RRC signaling) for a signal measured by a terminal; identifying a transmission interval of a signal measured by the terminal, on the basis of the received RRC signaling; identifying first information for forming a predetermined beam; and determining whether to change the first information for forming a beam to second information for forming a beam, on the basis of the identified transmission interval.

title: Method and device for adjusting multi pannels based on network assistance for inter-ue communication
abstract: An operation method of a first device 100 in wireless communication system is proposed. The method may comprise: receiving, from a second device 200 , information for first spatial setting; obtaining second spatial setting related to a second beam which does not cover a first beam related to the first spatial setting; and performing, to a third device 300 , an inter-device transmission based on the second spatial setting.

title: Adaptation of spatial reuse for extremely high throughput
abstract: This disclosure describes systems, methods, and devices related to spatial reuse for extremely high throughput (EHT). A device may identify a frame received from a first station device configured to operate in a first basic service set (BSS) on a first channel. The device may analyze a preamble of the frame to determine a classification of the frame. The device may adjust a calculation of a packet detection for overlapping basic service set (OBSS) value based on a number of unpunctured 20 MHz frequency channels. The device may determine to simultaneously use the first channel for communication with a second device within a second BSS based on the calculation of the packet detection for OBSS value.

title: Substrate processing apparatus, method of manufacturing article, substrate processing method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium
abstract: To provide a substrate processing apparatus capable of sufficiently suppressing the occurrence of temperature unevenness in the substrate surface of a substrate even when the substrate is conveyed at a high speed.SOLUTION: A substrate processing apparatus according to the present invention includes a stage on which a substrate is placed, a transfer unit configured to transfer the substrate from the stage, a measurement unit configured to measure a temperature of the transfer unit, an adjustment unit configured to adjust a temperature of the substrate placed on the stage, and a control unit configured to perform an adjustment step of adjusting the temperature of the substrate placed on the stage to the temperature of the transfer unit measured by the measurement unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: Mold
abstract: To provide a mold that can achieve both improved cooling efficiency and weight reduction.SOLUTION: The mold comprises: a mold portion having a first surface on which a recess having a predetermined shape is formed and a second surface opposite to the first surface; a base portion having a third surface on which an attachment portion to be attached to another member is formed, and a fourth surface opposite to the third surface; and a connection portion connecting the second surface and the fourth surface, wherein a void is formed in the connection portion, a hole penetrating between the first surface and the second surface is not formed, as a hole communicating with the void, in the mold portion, and a hole penetrating between the third surface and the fourth surface is not formed, as a hole communicating with the void, in the base portion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Printer
abstract: To provide a printer allowing for easily performing connection and separation between a mask cleaner and a movement mechanism in an inexpensive configuration.SOLUTION: A printer 1 includes: a mask cleaner 17 moving relatively to a mask 14 and thereby performing mask cleaning for removing paste adhering on a lower surface of the mask 14; and a camera movement mechanism 41 moving the mask cleaner 17 relatively to the mask 14. The mask cleaner 17 is moved while coupling with the camera movement mechanism 41 by coupling force caused by magnetic force of an electromagnet 61 to perform the mask cleaning, and then, separated from the camera movement mechanism 41 as the coupling force caused by the magnetic force of the electromagnet 61 is released at a retreat position which is set in a cleaner retreat area R3 on an outer side of a cleaning-target area R1 being a mask cleaning target.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title: Processing device
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a processing device which can be installed with space-saving, and performs continuous wafer grinding with simple configuration. SOLUTION: A processing device comprises: a plurality of chucks 22 for adsorbing and holding a wafer; an index table 21 which locates the plurality of chucks 22 on a concentric circle, and transports the plurality of chucks 22 between rough grinding means, medium grinding means, and fine grinding means; and a plurality of tilt mechanisms which respectively tilt each rotation axis of the plurality of chucks 22. Each perpendicular line L2 with respect to each of tilt shafts L1 of the plurality of tilt mechanisms passing through each of rotation centers O1 of the plurality of chucks 22 in a planar view is so set as to pass through a rotation center O2 of the index table 21. Further, a mechanism for tilting a rough grinding grindstone 41, a medium grinding grindstone 51, and a fine grinding grindstone 61 are not provided. title: Substrate treatment apparatus, method for manufacturing semiconductor device, and program
abstract: To provide a technology that can improve property of a film formed on a substrate while saving energy utilizing internal heat of a treatment vessel.SOLUTION: A substrate treatment apparatus includes: a treatment vessel for applying treatment to a substrate; a storage container at least partially coming into contact with an outside wall of the treatment vessel and storing a gas to be supplied into the treatment vessel; and a temperature control part for controlling internal temperature of the storage container.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Controlled release nutraceutical carrier and its manufacturing
abstract: A manufacturing process comprising vacuum assisted extraction coupled to ultrasound treatment of food by-products to obtain a controlled release agent comprising polysaccharides and polysaccharide bonded phenols is provided. A manufacturing process for food by-products comprising 3 cycles of vacuum instantaneous expansion, 15 minutes of ultrasound assisted extraction and pH of 1.5 to obtain polysaccharides with an increased range of antioxidant activity and a decreased zeta potential is also provided. A controlled release medicine comprising the controlled release agent obtained from the manufacturing processes is provided wherein the controlled release medicine comprises an active substance or beneficial microorganisms. The active agent may be selected from analgesics, antihistamines, digestives, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory agents, polyphenolic extracts, carotenoids, cannabinoids, and vitamins. The beneficial microorganism may be selected from Lactobacillus, Saccharomyces, Bifidobacterium, Streptococcus or Akkermansia. The bonded phenols may be gallic acid or polyphenols. The polysaccharide may be cellulose and hemicellulose. The food by-product is preferable persimmon (Diospyros kaki Thunb). [Fig: None]

title: Intestinal bacterial flora improver
abstract: To provide a new use of soybean isoflavone as a food material.SOLUTION: The present invention provides a composition containing soybean isoflavone as an active ingredient as an intestinal bacterial flora improver for use in suppressing a deterioration in the diversity of the intestinal bacterial flora.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Ages formation inhibitor and method for producing the same
abstract: To provide a safe and highly effective AGEs formation inhibitor.SOLUTION: An AGEs formation inhibitor comprises a pressurized enzymatic decomposition product of adlay.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Compositions for improving bacterial flora, methods for improving bacterial flora using same, and applications thereof
abstract: To provide compositions for improving bacterial flora and methods therefor.SOLUTION: The disclosure provides a composition for improving bacterial flora comprising one of a bacterium of the genus Lactobacillus or an extract thereof, a fucose-containing compound, and a fructan-containing compound. The disclosure also provides a method for producing improved bacterial flora, comprising the steps of: providing a culture fluid comprising one of a bacterium of the genus Lactobacillus or an extract thereof, a fucose-containing compound, and a fructan-containing compound; and culturing a bacterial flora in the culture fluid.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Composition for controlling proliferation of butyrate-producing bacteria, composition for controlling butyrate production, composition for controlling proliferation of bacteria of the genus bifidobacterium, and uses of same
abstract: The present invention provides: a composition for controlling the proliferation of butyrate-producing bacteria, said composition comprising at least one substance selected from among sugar alcohols and derivatives thereof; a composition for controlling butyrate production, said composition comprising a sugar alcohol derivative; a composition for controlling the proliferation of bacteria of the genus Bifidobacterium, said composition comprising a sugar alcohol derivative; and uses of the same.

title: Tension measuring device
abstract: Disclosed is a tension measuring device (100) used for measuring the tension of yarn, the device comprising: a sensor support (10); a pressure sensor (20) mounted on the sensor support and provided with a sensing part for acquiring a pressure; and a tension measuring rod (30) fixedly connected to the sensing part and used for receiving the pressure of a yarn. The tension measuring device is pressed onto the yarn, such that the pressure sensor can perform on-line measurement for the pressure of the yarn on the tension measuring rod without affecting the passing of the yarn, and the yarn tension can be obtained according to the corresponding relationship between the pressure of the yarn on the tension measuring rod and the yarn tension, such that on-line measurement of the yarn tension can be achieved, and the spinning quality is accordingly improved.

title: Method for measuring multiple parameters of drilling fluid
abstract: A method and apparatus for measuring multiple parameters of drilling fluid using electric field perturbation, permittivity curves, time domain analysis and frequency domain analysis to identify constituents of drilling fluid and ratios of the drilling fluid constituents on a real time basis and to measure volumes and densities of the constituents on a real time basis.

title: Method for electrical discharge machining
abstract: The invention relates to a method and device for electrical Wire electrical discharge machining method (WEDM) for forming a desired pattern on a workpiece by a WEDM machine tool, in which a preliminary voltage pulse is applied to a gap between a wire electrode and a workpiece, and in which, at the breakdown of said preliminary voltage pulse, a first machining discharge pulse is applied to the wire electrode. A discharge position of said first machining discharge pulse along the engagement line of the wire electrode and the workpiece is determined in real time based on the voltage signals and/or current signals generated by said first machining discharge pulse,and that at least one additional machining discharge pulse is selectively applied directly after the first machining discharge pulse, in which said selective application of the additional machining discharge pulse is based on the determined discharge position and based on a digital pattern representing the desired pattern.

title: Method for restoring a sealed chamber
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for restoring a sealed chamber (10) intended to be subjected to a specific pressure range higher than atmospheric pressure, comprising a first casing (12) and a second casing (14) which are intended to be mounted so as to bear against one another in a joint plane (P1). The method involves producing at least one groove (38) in at least one of the bearing surfaces (20, 22) of the joint plane (P1), along a contour to be sealed (Ce), the depth of the groove (38) varying along the contour to be sealed (Ce) according to certain measurements.

title: Electronic device for releasing emulsion and operation method therefor
abstract: According to an example, an electronic device may include a cartridge accommodation portion configured to accommodate a cartridge including emulsion therein, a crushing circuit including a crushing element that may crush at least a portion of the cartridge disposed in the cartridge accommodation portion, a processor configured to generate a crushing signal, and a transmission circuit configured to transmit the crushing signal to the crushing circuit, wherein the emulsion may be released to an outside of the electronic device by a microneedle, wherein the emulsion is exposed as at least the portion of the cartridge is crushed.
